title: Harden: pin the offline module posture in the verifier, and constrain module-graph directives
objective: Make the offline, standard-library-only module posture fail closed in ./scripts/verify-candidate and locally, not only inside the CI workflow, and record a repository policy that module-graph directives (replace, exclude, retract) are not used without review.
acceptance: verify-candidate runs product Go checks with the module environment pinned so an ambient GOFLAGS or warm module cache cannot turn a missing declaration into a silent pass
verify-candidate detects a parent-directory go.work or a committed vendor/ directory that would change module resolution for the repository
a repository policy statement records that replace, exclude and retract directives are not introduced without explicit review
nonGoals: do not add or remove any dependency
do not change the CI workflow
do not relax any existing check

blockers.description: go.work/vendor fail-closed detection and the replace/exclude/retract prohibition are defined neither in the specification (it never mentions verify-candidate; per spec/README it governs public product behavior) nor in any design document. Resolution owned by FJ-054: adjudicated as non-public behavior enforced against §17.2, §31, §2 and §23, and recorded via new acceptance-catalog rows C-QUAL-007..009 — the amendment vehicle already in this item's allowedFiles — following the FJ-050/FJ-052 pattern (gap recorded first, amendment by the owning item, then execution).

nextAction: none - FJ-054 closed; guard stack FJ-056/057/058 handoff follows (plan lifecycle fixed at 6f78a3b)
notes: PM 2026-09-26: opened from the FJ-053 hardener stage. Verified there: an undeclared import fails closed even with a warm cache and the proxy on, but four conditions bypass it — GOFLAGS=-mod=mod with a warm cache and GOPROXY=off, -mod=mod with a reachable proxy and GONOSUMDB, a parent-directory go.work, and a committed vendor/. Today the only offline enforcement is GOPROXY=off inside .github/workflows/ci.yml; scripts/verify-candidate contains no GOPROXY, GOFLAGS, go.sum or go mod reference at all.
